items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...like Coltrane , for instance, made one record where he was the side man.

ctx.x: Well, I was paid a little more than side man, you know.

Uh-huh. Yeah, well, you know, sometimes record companies do that, where they'll pay you -- they won't pay you a certain way, then they'll use your name as -- like Coltrane , for instance, made one record where he was the side man. Then when he became very famous, they put the record back out under his name. Didn't give him any more
